listing.name: Customizable Regalia
listing.summary: Yea, this. Makes Regalia from Tahlan Shipworks behave like Virtuous from Diable Avionics. Safe to add to existing save file, not safe to remove (duh). Enjoy your Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs with two energy weapons I guess.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the behavior of the Regalia mech to function like the Virtuous mech.

description: Modifies the Regalia mech from Tahlan Shipworks so that it behaves similarly to the Virtuous mech from Diable Avionics. This allows for configurations such as Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs equipped with two energy weapons.
